text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the George Bell Arena Board. This report recommends five candidates for appointment to the board.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidates to the George Bell Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on June 23, 2025, and until successors are appointed: - Vincent Berry - Maria Gervasi - Hannah McGregor - Fana Seife - Tom Vye
